title: Transport of an arbitrary ordinary inverse-exchange trace across an isomorphism
statement: Let A be a finite commutative ring, N a natural number annihilating A, t normalized finite twist transport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows], S a scheme with N invertible in global sections, and f:X → S proper with i:X ≅ P = ProjectiveLine(S) satisfying i.hom ≫ q = f. For any morphism τ:Rq* A_P(1)[2] → A_S and either Boolean projection a, middleComparison_a [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data], followed by Li* of projectionExchange_a [lem-sf-p1-chart-exchange], followed by Li* of (q*τ followed by ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback(q)), followed by constantComparison(i), equals coordinateTrace_a(τ). There is no splitting family, chart trace, trace base-change hypothesis, supported class or diagonal integral in this assertion; τ is arbitrary.

theorem projectionTraceTransport
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (i : X ≅ ProjectiveLine S) (hi : i.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S) = f)
    (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (τ : ordinaryFiniteP1SplittingTarget A N hA S ⟶ ordinaryFiniteUnit A S)
    (a : Bool) :
    middleComparison A N hA t f i hi hS a ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map (projectionExchange A N hA t S hS a) ≫
        (ordinaryFinitePullback A i.hom).map
          ((ordinaryFinitePullback A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).map τ ≫
            (ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback A (ProjectiveLine S ↘ S)).hom) ≫
        (constantComparison A i).hom =
      coordinateTrace A N hA t f i hi hS τ a
